name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (animate / warp_in_expand). Accurately reflects the body: a 10-frame warp-IN expand animation (counterpart to fd2_animate_warp_out_collapse @0x22547). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: 10-frame warp-IN expand animation: the warped character materializes at the destination tile inside an expanding filled-circle band (third/final visual stage of the character warp sequence).
logic_summary: for frame_iter 0..9: read sprite_addr from the 10-entry self-relative tile-anim table (*(int*)(tile_anim_base + 6 + frame_iter*4) + tile_anim_base); memmove the caller's snapshot backdrop into the large game-state buffer (0x25680); render a filled-circle band at (src_x,src_y) with CONSTANT radius 0xB and CONSTANT band-top 0 (so the circle grows only via the advancing sprite-table index, unlike the collapse half which shrinks); blit the composed buffer (+0x8088) to mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0504; wait 1 BIOS tick. Self-contained explicit RET at 0x226E9.
signature: void fd2_animate_warp_in_expand(uint32 dst_tile_x, uint32 dst_tile_y, uint32 snapshot, uint32 src_x, uint32 src_y, uint32 *warp_in_sprite, int radius)

params.reason: Read by the body as the band center X; accurate, no address residue.

params.reason: Read by the body as the band center Y; accurate, no address residue.

params.reason: Matches the caller's warp_in_sprite; descriptive, no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value (void). Self-contained epilogue with explicit RET at 0x226E9.
